projects.title: LocSav — Location journal
projects.tags: Java · Native Android · Google Maps · SQLite

placeholder.alt: Map illustration with a highlighted saved location

projects.explanation: A native Android app that lets users save locations and attach photos and information to each place, integrating Google Maps with a SQLite database.
projects.thoughtProcess: The app combines a map-based view of places with locally stored details, making it possible to keep a personal record of meaningful locations and the memories or notes associated with them.
projects.resultsSummary: Built a location-saving Android app using native Java development, Google Maps integration, and SQLite persistence.

projects.title: NBoard — Indic keyboard

placeholder.alt: Indic keyboard illustration with a highlighted language key

projects.explanation: Engineered NBoard as a custom native Android InputMethodService to make Marathi typing faster. A low-latency gesture decoder with spatial key-proximity scoring powers swipe input, alongside an ergonomic consonant-matra grid and an on-device Marathi prediction dictionary. Typing stays offline, with no cloud dependency or keystroke tracking.
projects.thoughtProcess: Standard mobile keyboards make Devanagari typing slow because of complex consonant-vowel matras and cramped layouts. NBoard replaces repeated taps with single-stroke gestures, pairing real-time touch-path recognition and spatial key-proximity scoring with a dedicated Marathi layout and word dictionary.
projects.resultsSummary: Delivers fast, accurate offline Marathi Devanagari swipe typing with on-device prediction, without cloud dependency or keystroke tracking.

projects.title: Genetic algorithm timetable

placeholder.alt: Timetable grid showing a generated schedule

projects.explanation: Built a constraint-aware genetic algorithm timetable optimizer in Java, exploring candidate schedules across multiple student groups to produce feasible timetables under competing resource constraints.
projects.thoughtProcess: The approach modelled timetable generation as a search problem, using constraints and candidate populations to explore schedules instead of relying on a single manually designed arrangement.
projects.resultsSummary: Automates timetable generation by evaluating competing constraints across student groups, helping planners focus on viable schedule options rather than manually assembling each one.

projects.title: Enterprise workflow platform

placeholder.alt: Workflow diagram connecting draft, review, and approval steps

projects.explanation: Architected the Java, Spring Boot, and Oracle backend for an enterprise workflow platform, delivering configurable approvals, versioned forms, and real-time collaboration for multi-team operations.
projects.thoughtProcess: The platform was designed around modular backend services, a flexible workflow engine, and clear ownership boundaries so changing enterprise requirements could be handled without rebuilding the entire system.
projects.resultsSummary: Shipped a production workflow platform in eight months with 50+ backend APIs, configurable approval flows, concurrency-safe forms, and real-time collaboration.

projects.title: Agent Shuka — Local AI knowledge assistant
projects.tags: Python · Ollama · LangChain · LlamaIndex · Chroma · Tailscale · Flutter

placeholder.alt: Local AI assistant connecting private documents to a local model

projects.explanation: Engineered a private, local-first knowledge assistant with Ollama, LlamaIndex, LangChain, and Chroma vector search. It indexes personal documents and runs LLM inference locally, while Tailscale enables remote access through a Flutter client.
projects.thoughtProcess: To preserve context across a conversation, the assistant summarizes the discussion before each response and considers that summary alongside the latest question, helping it answer in light of the broader conversation rather than only the newest message.
projects.resultsSummary: Delivered a document assistant combining local LLM inference, vector retrieval, conversational context, and remote access for private knowledge workflows.

projects.title: ArthShastra — Local finance management app
projects.tags: Flutter · Android Studio · Personal finance · Local-first

placeholder.alt: Personal finance illustration with separate budget categories

projects.explanation: A local-first personal finance app that helps users understand hedging and runway management by allocating money tokens to different purposes. It supports recording transactions from UPI activity or adding them later through a delayed manual-entry flow.
projects.thoughtProcess: The app makes financial planning more approachable by giving money clear purposes and helping users see how day-to-day transactions affect their runway and overall financial health, while keeping their data stored locally.
projects.resultsSummary: Designed to support healthier money habits through purpose-based budgeting, runway awareness, and flexible transaction tracking without requiring users to record every expense immediately.

projects.title: Nrup Shirts — Designer T-shirt venture
projects.tags: Entrepreneurship · Product design · Online & offline sales · Bootstrapped venture

placeholder.alt: T-shirt design illustration with fabric swatches

projects.explanation: An online and offline designer T-shirt business built around local culture and sentiment. The venture sold 20 shirts: 18 through local sales and 2 online organically.
projects.thoughtProcess: The experience highlighted how much a bootstrapped startup depends on validating demand, choosing an effective sales approach, and managing limited resources before committing further time and money.
projects.resultsSummary: The business did not become sustainable, but it provided a practical learning experience in entrepreneurship and the decisions to reconsider when building a bootstrapped startup.
